candidates.term: The Artisan at the Year Gate
candidates.defline: The Artisan stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: warmth and easy charm were the first things people saw in you.
candidates.reading: Affection reached you early and without effort, from the older relatives around you and from children you had only just met. Because being liked came so easily, you expect a welcome wherever you go, and you usually get one. Your body has run well on regular meals and sleep, and you feel the cost of too many late nights later than your friends do.
candidates.teaser: Warmth was your first language, learned young and worn openly. Doors open for you through charm and good taste, and they keep opening as long as you keep giving.

domain_readings.Social: Warmth is your opening move and it has never failed you: people relax on meeting you and remember the feeling. Your social capital compounds through hosting, feeding, and easing. Spend it generously. The circles you warm keep returning the temperature, usually with interest.
domain_readings.Health: Your constitution arrived friendly and stays friendly under rhythm: regular meals, honest sleep, pleasure taken without guilt. The risks in your chart are excess-shaped, never fragility-shaped. Alternate the feasts with quiet days and this body carries you smiling into old age.

candidates.life_chapter: Your early chapter was visibly sweet: charm noticed young, ease worn openly, doors that opened because you were pleasant to have around. The generosity you learned in those years remains your best economics. Expect life to keep feeding whoever keeps feeding others. That was always the deal.
candidates.relations: The warm elders are this seat’s people: whoever praised, fed, and enjoyed you early set your template for care. You repay them by becoming them. Host the family table when it passes to you. It will, and it should.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the warmth banks itself: charm intact, invitations declined. Accept three this month. Your luck circulates only when you do.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, the sweetness overpours: pleasing everyone, becoming furniture. Warm the deserving. Lukewarm is fine for the rest.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, charm becomes the whole job: liked everywhere, known nowhere.
candidates.health_line: Your body forgives generously and remembers eventually: indulgence compounds quietly. Keep the pleasures rhythmic and the body stays your friend.

Social.headline: You are welcomed in almost any company.
Social.recognition: People warm to you on first meeting, and they remember how you made them feel long after the talk itself. Since being liked was your first way of belonging, you give more than you take in every circle you join, through hosting and small kindnesses. Your friends are many and loyal, and you show your worries to very few of them.
Social.lived: Other children wanted to sit next to you, and the adults at family gatherings made a fuss of you. By your teens you were asked to more parties than you could go to, and you went to most of them.

Health.headline: You were born with a forgiving body.
Health.recognition: You recover quickly from big meals and short nights, and your body has rarely let you down. Because pleasure has never felt dangerous to you, you let the treats and the late nights pile up until your energy drops. A steady routine of food and rest puts you right, and you feel well again within a week of going back to it.
Health.lived: You ate well and slept soundly in your first years, and a bad day or a cold never kept you down for long. Food at home was a pleasure more than a rule, and by your teens you loved a good meal more than most of your friends did.

The constitution is genuinely good, and it stays good on rhythm rather than discipline. Keep the meals, the sleep, and the company regular. Your luck has manners, and it likes being fed.
